lines.name: One degree inland of the East African coast
lines.basis: Computed from public/data/land.geojson: for each degree of latitude between 20S and 1S, the easternmost mainland longitude, minus one degree. Two latitudes were dropped where the scan caught Madagascar and the Comoros instead of the mainland.

regions.name: The Swahili coast
regions.basis: The coastal strip and islands from Sofala to the Lamu archipelago -- Sofala, Kilwa, Mafia, Zanzibar, Pemba, Mombasa, Gede and Pate, the places the Swahili coast article names. The inland limit is not drawn by hand: it is one degree west of the real coastline, read off Natural Earth land at each degree of latitude, because these were port towns with a hinterland of tens of kilometres and not territorial states reaching into the interior.
